name: 5 Loaves Ministries Food Pantry
hoursNotes: Tuesday and Thursday mornings from 8am, plus Thursday evenings 5–7pm; service is bi-weekly by last name (A–M and N–Z alternate weeks) — call to confirm the current schedule and your week.
requirements: Proof of address (utility bill or ID); must reside in Sachse, Garland, Wylie, Murphy, Richardson, or Rowlett; verbal income verification. No appointment required; drive-up or walk-in.
affiliation: Church of Christ (ministry of NorthPointe Church of Christ)
notes: Sachse's main food pantry; also distributes diapers, wipes, and occasional household essentials.
